payload.note: Dual-CHEF fire at 05:15 boundary: chef-morning (daily guaranteed, ~24h) + chef-intraday (05:13 hourly cron tick). pressure_mode=legacy because pressure-state.stale_warning=false forced fallback (AC-P1-6-3), bypassing cadence gate that would have suppressed chef-intraday on off-market (240min default, 62min elapsed). Two unified-agent instances spawned in parallel; each self-gates via published-marker + conditional-intraday logic. NOTE: stale_warning persisting across multiple ticks is now causing behavioral drift (legacy-forced redundant intraday fires) — dev-team should investigate why emit_pressure_state keeps setting stale_warning=true. Minor: initial last_fired write used %3N (unsupported on macOS BSD date) producing malformed .3NZ; repaired in-cycle to valid .000Z ISO8601.
